snippet.title: Axobubble | Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
#AfilGames #Axobubble

✨ Axobubble Launch Trailer ✨
🦎 Available for Nintendo Switch, Playstation 4, Playstation 5, Xbox Series X|S, Xbox One and Microsoft Store!

In Axobubble you play as a friendly axolotl who creates floating bubbles to use as temporary platforms. With 30 levels full of day and night challenges, you’ll need creativity and precision to overcome traps, face enemies, and collect shells on your way to the big star. A 2D platformer that’s simple to start but full of possibilities! ⭐

KEY FEATURES
✨ Bubble-platform creation to reach new heights and cross gaps;
✨ 30 hand-crafted levels with day and night challenges;
✨ Dynamic obstacles from spikes and geysers to crabs and saws;
✨ Accessible platforming with hidden areas that reward creativity;

Get yours 👇🏻👇🏻👇🏻
⭐ Nintendo Switch: https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/axobubble-switch/
⭐ Playstation: https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10016372
⭐ Xbox Series X|S: https://www.xbox.com/en-us/games/store/axobubble/9NNKLVDV1GTR
⭐ Xbox One: https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/store/p/axobubble-xbox-one/9ph434r94jnb
⭐ Microsoft Store: https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/store/p/axobubble-windows/9p7425khdj1q
